verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user- or agent-initiated bulk operation, such as selecting many errors and resolving, assigning, or deleting them together via the UI, API, CLI, or MCP. The closest item is the automatic resolution of all unresolved errors when a deploy is recorded. That is a deploy-triggered side effect, an adjacent behavior rather than a bulk-operations capability. Cross-project search and fault listing are read-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
